reviews.reason: Initial six-case fixed profile. Reviewed five actual paired trials against the merged PR #56 baseline: all seven deterministic counters and bytes are identical before/after and below the proposed ceilings. Most positive operation ceilings retain 20-50% headroom; tiny counts round up, zero paths/candidates stay strict, and the 6000-step boundary stays exact. Canonical trajectory storage allows approximately twice measured bytes. These are regression ceilings, not product capacity or wall-time/RSS guarantees. Existing boundary fixtures and the new missing/over-budget metric canaries remain required; no failed baseline or missing observation is waived.
